risk_description: The leather of the instrument panel in the area of the passenger airbag may not be correctly bonded. In case of activation of the passenger airbag, deployment may be impeded, which may increase the risk of injury to the passenger in the event of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
